items.item_text: resume
cover letter

The Computer-Based Testing Facility (CBTF) Operational Support Specialist provides extended CBTF coverage to support evening testing hours as the service grows and demand increases to provide testing times that support student preferences. This position provides tier 2 support between the student proctors and CBTF team leads and administers testing operations at Computer Based Testing Facilities locations, including facilities, student services, instructor services, communications, information technology and safety.
Administers testing operations at Computer Based Testing Facilities (CBTF) locations, including facilities, student services, instructor services, communications, information technology and safety.
General facility coverage during standard operating hours as needed for student backup.
Participates in the development and revision of standard operating procedures and guidelines.
Delivers testing instructions to students in person and performs thorough check-ins to ensure no unauthorized aids are being brought into the testing room.
Applies knowledge of accommodations and students with disabilities to appropriately and properly provide accommodations and service to students.
Supports and enhances student academic success by providing prompt, courteous, and professional customer support to students, faculty, and staff.
Implements security procedures that protect academic integrity and responds to possible academic integrity violations and/or student conduct issues according to protocols.
Ensures operability of computerized testing systems and provides simple to moderately complex technical support as second line of escalation.
Student Staff Oversight - 30%
Perform Regular check-ins/drop-ins of facilities to verify tasks handled by students are being performed correctly.
General student proctor support including communication, task assignment, and oversight to help resolve timely escalated issues in person or via internal communication channels when needed.
Direct escalated issues to the appropriate staff member/team as required.
Provides clear direction and instruction to student proctors, and monitors student staff.
Inventory and Operational Management - 20%
Weekly checks of facilities to include inventory of supplies (paper, pens, earplugs, etc); confirming usability/no damage to equipment and furniture, and escalating any urgent needs as appropriate.
Development of purchasing lists/purchase ticket creation to ensure supply management.
Prepares reports or analyses of operational activities, evaluates current and proposed services, etc.
Provides information to students, faculty and staff, and the public about test policies, requirements, procedures, and best assessment practices.
Implements standards and policies for the security and integrity of student data and test materials.
Maintain clear, accurate and complete records of student testing instances.
Develops expertise in assessment platforms being used by the CBTF in order to effectively advise and support instructors and students.
Other duties as assigned by supervisor - 5%
Ability to work evening hours. This position will provide operational coverage after 5pm on weekdays.
Working knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Solid communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff verbally and in writing.
Solid organizational skills and ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
